create_rnn_state_encoder: create an RNN state encoder with configurable input size, hidden size, layers, and GRU or LSTM type
initialize_rnn_parameters: initialize RNN weights with orthogonal initialization and biases to zero
encode_single_timestep: encode a single non-sequence input timestep with hidden state and masking
encode_sequence_timesteps: encode a sequence of timesteps with masked hidden state propagation across zero-masked segments
pack_unpack_hidden_states: pack and unpack LSTM hidden and cell states into a single concatenated tensor
